always: Every material is rendered as smooth, soft, rounded 3D-toy plastic or clay: surfaces are airbrushed gradients with no visible brush strokes, noise, pores or scratches.
Highlights are soft, broad and blurry-edged, never hard specular dots; shadows are soft colored gradients. Rim lights and soft bounce edges are present on forms.

Texture is separate from the surface: a few big bold hand-placed marks (wood plank lines, chain links, pineapple diamonds, glove creases, pillow ribs) sit on a smooth base instead of a continuous fine grain.
Detail is simplified to chunky readable shapes; small parts (stitches, rivets, screws, buttons) are either absent or turned into large toy-like dots and bumps.
Color inside a surface shifts smoothly (hue shift in shadow, lighter warm edge), not by tiny texture variation.
varies: Gloss: boxing gloves, fins, phone booth, watering can and sneaker sole read semi-gloss with soft sheen; the pillow, pump body and book cover are near-matte; glass, drink glasses and gauge faces get the only crisp glints.

Micro-texture strength: the pillow has faint fabric weave, the sneaker has a perforated mesh dot pattern, wood has drawn streaks, and the flat ticket and sticker icons have none. Others are fully smooth.
Wood grain is large and decorative: orange-stripe streaks on the table and book background, chunky carved ring segments on the palm trunk, thin plank lines on the red bench. Scale is bold, not fine.
Metals (chains, trowel, gauge bezel, pump nozzle) are painted as flat gray or blue-gray with a soft light edge, not real chrome reflections.
Flat vector-style cards (ticket) have zero material texture; 3D cards have soft volumetric shading.
never: No hard specular glints on large surfaces, no mirror chrome or environment reflections.
No fine fabric weave, leather pores, stitching or rivet detail at small scale.
No scratches, dirt, wear, fingerprints or edge chipping, except the pump base's stylized gray patches.
No visible brush strokes, painterly texture, grain noise or photo realism.
No matte-and-shiny mix within one object that goes beyond a soft glow on the same plastic.
generator_wording: Smooth soft toy-plastic and clay surfaces with airbrushed gradients, no noise or brush strokes. Soft broad blurry highlights, rare small crisp glints only on glass or gauges. Surface marks are few, large and bold: chunky wood streaks, big chain links, simple ribs. No fine stitching, pores, scratches or realistic metal reflections.
